name: rbox-workspace
description: Development commands for the rbox Rust workspace and bindings

scripts.test:js: npm run build:js && npm --prefix bindings/javascript test
scripts.test:py: npm run build:py && cd bindings/python && python -m pytest tests
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.build:py: cd bindings/python && python -m maturin develop --extras test
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:js && npm run build:py
scripts.build:release: npm run build:rust:release && npm run build:js:release && npm run build:py:release
